_about: Arrival pacing (see ArrivalPacing). Each meal runs for its meal_seconds on its own clock. Customers come in one at a time while fewer than the cap are 'waiting for food' (arriving, at the host stand, being seated, or seated but not served yet; eating doesn't count, and a friend walking in with someone counts as part of their arrival). When there's room, the next one comes after a random gap: empty_gap when nobody's inside at all, else the player-count gap times the phase's gap_scale. Arrivals stop in the last quiet_last seconds of a phase that has it, and when the meal's time is up; the bell can be rung once everyone's gone. Regulars and the critic planned for a meal always get in before then.
_phases: The day curve, in order. Each sits in one meal, from..to seconds of that meal's clock. cap_add is added to the player-count cap; gap_scale multiplies its gap (smaller = closer together). rush: true calls out the rush as it starts (rush_text) and allows surprises. quiet_last: no arrivals in that many seconds at the end of the phase.
_players: By how many players are in (read live: someone joining or leaving changes the next arrival straight away). cap: how many can be waiting for food at once, before the phase's cap_add. gap: [min, max] seconds after a slot opens. pair_scale: times the chance a townsfolk walks in with a friend (service.json pair_chance).
_surprise: In a rush phase, chance of each arrival that someone else walks in surprise_delay seconds behind them, even at the cap (never past cap + 1).
_regulars: Who the next arrival is: a regular planned for this meal is picked regular_chance of the time, times window_boost while it's inside their visit_window (a list of phase ids in their character file). Once the meal's arrival time left is under urgent_seconds for each regular still to come, they're next. The critic is picked like a regular. Everyone else is townsfolk.
_bonuses: Hooks that add to the cap on top of everything else. per_staff: for each hired staff member (none can be hired yet). stars: by the restaurant's star rating.
